Terms of Use

Important boundaries for using Milaan's payment reconciliation assistance.

Draft for review. This page includes [BRACKETED PLACEHOLDERS] that the owner must complete before treating it as final. A qualified lawyer should review it. Do not rely on it as a compliance certification.

What Milaan does

Milaan compares the order details, payment screenshots and statement records that you provide. It suggests SHIP, HOLD or REVIEW based on those records. It does not connect to your bank, guarantee that a screenshot is genuine, or independently confirm that money reached your account.

Your responsibility

You must confirm the receiving account, statement period, full Transaction ID, payment status and other evidence. You are responsible for deciding whether to ship, refund, hold or seek more information. Treat uncertain results as REVIEW; a recommendation is not a fraud finding.

AI limitations

If you consent to Google's Gemini reading of a receipt, it may misread or miss details. Review extracted values against the source image and your own account statement. Do not treat AI output as verified evidence.

Acceptable use

Use Milaan only for financial records and payment evidence that you are entitled to process. Do not upload unlawful content, infringe others' rights, or attempt to access another seller's account or records.
